description: Implementation of the transmitter component for a radio system, including configuration generation, dependency resolution, and control methods for starting/stopping transmission, and accessors for handlers and metrics.

classes.name: transmitter_impl
classes.description: Implements the transmitter logic, managing downlink and uplink handlers, message transmission, and metrics collection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the OTA dispatcher, uplink task dispatcher, and downlink handler.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the downlink handler, uplink task dispatcher, and OTA dispatcher.

methods.name: get_uplink_request_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the uplink request handler.

methods.name: get_downlink_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the downlink handler.

methods.name: get_ota_symbol_boundary_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the OTA symbol boundary notifier.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns pointer to the metrics collector, or nullptr if disabled.
